shots.line: A fly zips past your face.
shots.note: a fly zips across frame right past Pip's nose, its trail looping; his eyes snap after it and glint cyan
time slows: the fly hangs, wings beating slowly; Pip's mitten whips in and snaps shut round it
Pip at the island, fist held up, smug; behind him Mo freezes mid-swing with a rolled magazine
Pip's elbow nudges the phone; it tips off the lit desk edge toward the blurred floor

shots.size: low angle at floor level, slow motion
shots.note: the phone hangs a hand above the floorboards, turning slowly; Pip's hand whips in and catches it
Pip back in his chair, already scrolling the phone, not even looking: cool

shots.size: over the shoulder, ball on the spot
shots.note: Mo's boot swings in past camera, the ball flies at the top corner; Pip ready in goal under the floodlights
time slows: Pip at full stretch in the air under the crossbar, his mittens close on the ball in the top corner
the ball pressed into Pip's two mittens, the net billowing behind, floodlight flare
balls keep coming; Pip catches every one without moving his eyes, a pile grows at his feet, Mo sinks to his knees; SAVED 47/47

shots.line: What if you reacted ten times faster?
shots.note: the premise over the city at dusk; Pip on the roof spinning a football on one finger; a stopwatch reads 0.025 s
Pip at the start line, smug, the floodlights soft behind; then a flicker of doubt

shots.size: wide, side-on, over the starter's arm
shots.note: Pip in lane 4 and Mo in lane 5 crouched in the blocks; the starter's pistol up in the dark foreground

shots.line: react faster than a tenth of a second and it's
shots.note: BANG at 0 s; a red zone up to 0.100 s marked FALSE START; NORMAL 0.25 s; then YOU 0.025 s drops deep in the red
Pip is three strides gone while the gun smoke is still a puff; Mo still crouched; a red light flashes
the scoreboard: LANE 4 PIP R.T. 0.025, FALSE START blinking red, then DQ stamps on
Pip, worried, the light turning red on him

shots.line: And somebody in a black car
shots.note: a black car at the kerb under a streetlight, the floodlights beyond the fence; its rear window down, the suit watching
the suit's face lit from below by a tablet reading 0.025 s; his eyes slide to us; the tinted window glides up; the headlights snap on
